name: Movenpick Hotel Hanoi Centre
short_description: A 155-room hotel on Ly Thuong Kiet Street in the French Quarter, recently renovated, within walking distance of Hanoi's Old Quarter and cultural landmarks.
ai_summary: Movenpick Hotel Hanoi Centre sits on Ly Thuong Kiet Street in Hanoi's iconic French Quarter, within walking distance of the city's cultural and historical landmarks and the Old Quarter. The 155 non-smoking rooms and suites recently underwent an intensive renovation and upgrade, and the hotel offers an outdoor pool and full-service spa. Guests consistently praise the great location, comfortable and spacious rooms, and excellent breakfast catering to a range of tastes, making it a solidly reviewed mid-range option in central Hanoi.

faqs.question: Is Movenpick Hotel Hanoi Centre close to the Old Quarter?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's on Ly Thuong Kiet Street in Hanoi's French Quarter, within walking distance of the Old Quarter and many of the city's cultural and historical landmarks.

faqs.question: Has Movenpick Hotel Hanoi Centre been renovated recently?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the hotel underwent an intensive renovation and upgrade, and guest feedback since reflects the improved room quality favourably.
